angle: Microsoft raised the price of Office, called it a 'packaging and pricing update', and the official FAQ explaining it contains no prices.
title: CASE No. 0001 - The Pricing Update With No Pricing In It
button_document: Microsoft's own licensing FAQ page, title bar visible, scrolled to show no price figures. STAMP lands on it.

lines.text: Microsoft put the price of Office up.
They're calling it a packaging and pricing update.
That's the actual title. Packaging and Pricing Updates for Microsoft 365 Commercial Suites. Public FAQs.
The FAQ about the price increase has no prices in it. It links to a table.
It's a pricing update with no pricing in it.
That's not an FAQ. That's a hostage video.
E3 went from twenty-three dollars a seat to twenty-six.
So somebody sat down, wrote the whole explanation, and took the number out.
That's not an oversight. That's a craft.
This change reflects the significant innovation delivered over the last several years, and the expanded value customers will gain.
microsoft.com  -  no prices on this page
